remarks: Turnkey, this better than new custom Silvermine Colonial offers over 4,000 sq. ft. of beautifully finished living space in a serene, tranquil setting near the Silvermine Golf Course & Wilton border. This home offers 4 BRs & 4 1/2 Baths. The stunning chef's kitchen features S/S appliances, marble countertops, a wet bar, large island, & a sunny dining area that opens seamlessly to the family room & backyard. A powder room & mudroom add everyday convenience. The L/R w/bay window & the formal D/R showcase the home's exceptional millwork & high-end finishes. The spacious 2nd floor includes a luxurious primary suite w/spa bath, doublesink vanity, radiant heated floors & two large W/I closets. A second bedroom enjoys its own bath, while two additional bedrooms share a Jack & Jill bath. The finished L/L offers over 1,000 sq. ft. w/full bath-perfect for a gym, office, media room, or rec space. A walk-up, floored attic w/high ceilings, spray foam insulation & large windows provides expansion potential. Outdoors, the property has an oversized bluestone patio, fenced rear yard, stone walls, storage shed & lighting. A wholehouse Generac generator & irrigation system enhance comfort & peace of mind. Recent improvements include full interior repainting, new designer lighting throughout, new walkway, & extensive landscaping. Ideally located just minutes to restaurants, shopping, train stations, & hwys. This this home offers the perfect blend of serenity, convenience & modern living.
